scenes.text: This tutorial covers Motility assay. Quantify velocity, displacement, persistence, and infection quality-control metrics from time-resolved images.
Open Motility assay from the Core section. Open tracked timelapse data with reliable time intervals and spatial calibration.
In the main configuration area, choose track filters, minimum duration, smoothing, motility metrics, infection definitions, and well-level groups.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. inspect trajectory previews and exclude broken, stationary-artifact, or implausible tracks.
When the workflow finishes, spaCR writes per-track and per-condition motility tables, quality metrics, and figures.
